title: fix(adjacency): order by the position method when adjacent_by has no within

files.patch:
@@ -7,13 +7,13 @@ module Adjacency
 
       class_methods do
         def adjacent_by(position_method, within: {})
-          return unless within.present?
-
-          grouping_method = within.is_a?(Hash) ? within.keys.first : within
+          grouping_method = within.is_a?(Hash) ? within.keys.first : within.presence
           grouping_order = within.is_a?(Hash) ? within.values.first : nil
 
           define_method(:next) do
             resources = self.class.all.sort_by do |resource|
+              next resource.public_send(position_method) unless grouping_method
+
               group_value = resource.public_send(grouping_method)
 
               group_order = if grouping_order
@@ -32,6 +32,8 @@ def adjacent_by(position_method, within: {})
 
           define_method(:previous) do
             resources = self.class.all.sort_by do |resource|
+              next resource.public_send(position_method) unless grouping_method
+
               group_value = resource.public_send(grouping_method)
 
               group_order = if grouping_order

   test "alphabetical: groups by section and orders sections alphabetically" do
@@ -114,4 +115,31 @@ def self.all
     assert_nil ungrouped.next
     assert_equal second.id, ungrouped.previous.id
   end
+
+  test "without within: orders by the position method instead of the collection order" do
+    resource_class = Class.new do
+      include Perron::Resource::Adjacency
+
+      attr_reader :id, :position
+
+      def initialize(id, position)
+        @id = id
+        @position = position
+      end
+
+      def self.all
+        @all ||= [new("third", 3), new("first", 1), new("second", 2)]
+      end
+
+      adjacent_by :position
+    end
+
+    third, first, second = resource_class.all
+
+    assert_equal second.id, first.next.id
+    assert_equal third.id, second.next.id
+    assert_nil third.next
+    assert_equal first.id, second.previous.id
+    assert_nil first.previous
+  end
 end
